acceptance_criteria.evidence: Code returns unchanged complete PlayState. Independent c/w/j/h/n/v/b pending-Start flow has complete10-row journal payload equality with legacy baseline. acceptance_criteria.criterion: Factual dialogue, publication and error recovery
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Actual Start/relief screens distinguish stock narrator from AI wording. Exact512-character cached AI text remains in journal with cache0calls. Waiting header is neutral for both offers and active-work check-ins; IO flush occurs after request publication and before lookup. CI verifies cached origins, pending stock fallback, publication failure and actual indicator deltas.

Exact-head required CI fully succeeds, including eight compiled/killed mutations and existing social regression. Both strict-quality reports have no gates. Raw proof errors and source-property skips are retained, not called proofs. Package/CLI changelogs, AGENT docs, reusable demo and story limits are present. Root owns post-verdict sprint closure/archive.

documentation_check.design_doc_status: Implementation accepted; parent archives design/companion and completes sprint metadata after this verdict.

design_fidelity.notes: Focused pure AILANG screen composition and a coherent crew preparation exercise reuse the original authoritative host, library and policies. Default80x24 refinement is explicit and approved;80x28/60x24 targets remain validated. No mechanic, provider/model, schema or contact simulation changes.

feedback.issue: Expanded nested startup function remains over50lines, costing2points under the evaluator rubric.
feedback.suggestion: Future cleanup can extract configuration/policy/startup-publication helpers while preserving legacy output and exact journal payloads. This is nonblocking for landing.

resolved_findings: Onboarding raw input and action-count guards added.
Policy meanings and active project/relief cost context remain visible while reading.
Prompt row fits total frame dimensions; plain frame-boundary harness corrected.
Waiting wording no longer falsely says active work has not started.
Modern recap/fatal displays sanitize controls without rewriting journals.
Wide symbols undercount fixed with conservative unknown-glyph width; independently measured actual host wcwidth.
Initial empty-list proof spelling corrected; remember history-bound precondition added; remaining encoder limits explicit.
New public entry boundary avoids vacuous inventory-only unit contracts.
strongest_remaining_risk: Terminal appearance still depends on manual dimensions and conservative codepoint measurement. Full grapheme/emoji shaping, automatic resize/TTY detection and raw-key input are intentionally unsupported; unknown glyphs may use extra space. Actual user taste remains a feedback matter, not established by test counts.
limitations: All reviewer flows were offline; no live AI/provider calls were made.
Source-property skips and SMT encoder failures are not proofs or named-test failures.
This is a standalone preparation exercise, not Godot integration, a save/resume system, simulated alien contact or a game-winning score.
Sprint status/velocity and archive transitions are the parent post-verdict step; no circular requirement for the independent review to be already completed.
notes: PASS is based on actual ANSI frames, newcomer/story review, real pending-choice navigation, independent width/provenance probes and exact-source CI, not test inventory alone. Reviewer changed no sources, installed no commands, committed/pushed/merged nothing and delegated no work.
